items.title: Additionality of climate benefits from emission reduction and carbon dioxide removal
items.title_en: Additionality of climate benefits from emission reduction and carbon dioxide removal
items.title_zh: 减排与二氧化碳移除所带来气候效益的增量性
items.summary_en: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) has been identified as a necessary complement to industrial decarbonization for climate change mitigation. Marine CDR (mCDR) approaches, such as ocean alkalinity enhancement (OAE) and direct ocean capture (DOC), have received considerable attention for their potential to counteract ocean acidification while simultaneously reducing atmospheric CO2. However, most model-based assessments of mCDR efficacy either assume a fixed background atmospheric CO2 value or adopt an idealized future CO2 trajectory, thereby excluding impacts of important carbon cycle feedbacks that repartition carbon between the ocean, atmosphere, and biosphere. Here, we use an Earth system model to address three core questions: whether the net CO2 effect of CDR depends on background emissions; whether CDR technologies deployed simultaneously yield additive CO2 reductions; and whether there is synergy between the radiative forcing (climate) benefits of CDR and emission reductions. We evaluate permutations of direct air capture, OAE, and DOC, quantifying their individual and combined CO2 effects under various emissions scenarios. We find that the radiative forcing effects of emissions reductions and CDR are largely additive through time, regardless of background emission scenario or CDR type or scale. Furthermore, any given quantity and type of short-term CDR deployment produces a predictable, proportional and durable reduction in atmospheric CO2 through time (ΔlnCO2), facilitating comparison between CDR strategies. Finally, we show that CDR efficacy is marginally greater at low background CO2, supporting the complementary value of decarbonization and CDR in carbon management portfolios. These findings provide a robust physical basis for the design of integrated carbon management strategies and support pursuit of deep emissions cuts and CDR as synergistic climate levers.
items.summary_zh: 二氧化碳捕集与封存（CDR）已被认定为工业脱碳在减缓气候变化方面不可或缺的补充措施。 海洋二氧化碳移除（mCDR）方法，例如海洋碱度增强（OAE）和直接海洋捕获（DOC），因其既能抵消海洋酸化，又能同时减少大气中二氧化碳的潜力而备受关注。 然而，大多数基于模型的 mCDR 效用评估要么假设大气 CO₂ 背景值固定，要么采用理想化的未来 CO₂ 轨迹，从而排除了重要碳循环反馈的影响——这些反馈会在海洋、大气和生物圈之间重新分配碳。 在此，我们利用地球系统模型探讨三个核心问题：碳捕获与封存（CDR）的净二氧化碳效应是否取决于背景排放水平；同时部署的CDR技术能否产生累加的二氧化碳减排效果；以及CDR的辐射强迫（气候）效益与减排措施之间是否存在协同效应。 我们评估了直接空气捕获、海洋吸收增强（OAE）和直接碳捕获（DOC）的各种组合方案，量化了它们在不同排放情景下的单独及综合二氧化碳减排效果。研究发现，无论背景排放情景、CDR类型或规模如何，减排与CDR的辐射强迫效应在时间上基本呈累加关系。 此外，任何特定数量和类型的短期碳捕获与移除部署，都会随时间推移带来可预测、成比例且持久的 атмосферный CO₂ 减排（ΔlnCO₂），从而便于对不同碳捕获与移除策略进行比较。 最后，我们表明，在低背景二氧化碳浓度下，碳捕获与封存（CDR）的效能略有提高，这印证了脱碳与CDR在碳管理组合中的互补价值。这些发现为设计综合碳管理策略提供了坚实的物理依据，并支持将深度减排与CDR作为协同的气候调控手段加以推进。

items.title: Spatially compounding climate extremes and environmental risk: cross-regional synchrony, spatial buffering loss, and systemic consequences
items.title_en: Spatially compounding climate extremes and environmental risk: cross-regional synchrony, spatial buffering loss, and systemic consequences
items.title_zh: 气候极端事件与环境风险的空间叠加效应：跨区域同步性、空间缓冲作用的丧失及系统性后果
items.summary_en: Spatially compounding climate extremes are increasingly recognized as a source of climate-related risk, and their risk significance depends on how synchrony affects connected systems. The critical transition occurs when cross-regional synchrony reduces support from places that would otherwise buffer one another through substitution, reserve capacity, mutual assistance or recovery support—a condition we term spatial buffering loss (BL). This topical review synthesizes empirical and methodological evidence to examine how synchrony is generated, when it translates into functional loss, and what is required to assess that transition. Food production, water allocation and firefighting cooperation provide complementary settings for examining substitution, reserve and assistance functions, while the synthesis distinguishes joint exposure from support available to recipients. Atmospheric circulation, persistent weather patterns, land–atmosphere feedbacks and hydrological connectivity can organize synchrony; functional evidence determines whether that synchrony reduces compensating support and produces systemic consequences. Accordingly, credible assessment must connect event topology and joint-tail behaviour with functional exposure, an explicit compensating relation and a counterfactual estimate of support that would otherwise have remained available. By linking event organization to recipient support, the synthesis provides a functional basis for assessing spatial BL across connected systems. This perspective connects the evidence to decisions about supplier diversification, reserve operation and mutual assistance.
items.summary_zh: 人们越来越认识到，空间上叠加的气候极端事件是气候相关风险的来源之一，其风险重要性取决于同步性如何影响相互关联的系统。 当跨区域同步性削弱了原本可通过替代、储备能力、互助或恢复支持来相互缓冲的地区之间的支撑作用时，就会发生关键性转变——我们将这种状况称为“空间缓冲损失”（BL）。 本专题综述综合了实证和方法论证据，以考察同步性是如何产生的、何时会导致功能丧失，以及评估这一转变需要什么条件。粮食生产、水资源分配和消防合作为考察替代、储备和援助功能提供了互补的背景，而本综述则将联合暴露与受助方可获得的支持区分开来。 大气环流、持续性天气模式、陆地-大气反馈以及水文连通性均可促成同步性；功能性证据则决定了这种同步性是否会削弱补偿性支持并产生系统性后果。 因此，可信的评估必须将事件拓扑结构和联合尾部行为与功能性暴露、明确的补偿关系以及对原本仍可获得的支持的反事实估计联系起来。 通过将事件组织与受助方支持联系起来，该综合研究为评估互联系统中的空间BL提供了功能性基础。这一视角将证据与关于供应方多元化、储备运作及互助的决策联系起来。

items.title: Evolving energy-water infrastructure strengthens drought resilience in the U.S. Northeast and Midwest
items.title_en: Evolving energy-water infrastructure strengthens drought resilience in the U.S. Northeast and Midwest
items.title_zh: 不断发展的能源和水利基础设施增强了美国东北部和中西部地区抵御干旱的能力
items.summary_en: Strategies to strengthen regional water security will be essential for navigating a critical 21st-century environmental challenge: securing freshwater supplies against growing demands and increasingly severe climate extremes. This paper assesses the evolution of water security in the historically water-rich U.S. Northeast (NE) and Midwest (MW) to quantify their resilience to severe drought now and in the future. We develop a counterfactual framework that projects sectoral water demands based on socio-economic drivers and deconstructs the benefits of supply- and demand-side adaptations at the regional scale. During the half-century between the historic NE/MW 1960s drought and the 2012–2013 North American drought, rapid socio-economic growth held the potential to push water systems to a breaking point, rendering them unequipped to manage the impact of such severe droughts. However, this study reveals that both regions built resilience through long-term adaptations that averted potential water crises, mitigating otherwise severe summertime water stress (withdrawal-to-available supply) by factors of 2.8 (MW) and 5.6 (NE). While supply-side strategies through reservoir construction and coastal power development played a role, the driving factor has been water demand management, accounting for 83% to 92% of summertime water stress mitigations across the two regions and drought scenarios. These gains were rooted in economic and political incentives to adopt advanced thermoelectric cooling technologies and efficient industrial technologies, together with the regions’ shift from a manufacturing to service economy. Thus, our projections of increased water demand by the mid-21st century highlight a critical reality: future drought resilience will require continued investments in demand-side efficiency gains, such as water-efficient electricity production systems, to keep pace with expected socio-economic trends.
items.summary_zh: 为应对21世纪这一关键的环境挑战——在需求不断增长和气候极端事件日益加剧的背景下保障淡水供应——加强区域水安全的策略至关重要。 本文评估了历史上水资源丰富的美国东北部（NE）和中西部（MW）地区水安全状况的演变，以量化这些地区当前及未来应对严重干旱的韧性。 我们构建了一个反事实框架，该框架基于社会经济驱动因素对各行业用水需求进行预测，并从区域层面剖析了供需两端适应措施带来的效益。 在1960年代东北部和中西部历史性干旱与2012–2013年北美干旱之间的半个世纪里，迅猛的社会经济发展曾有可能将水系统推向崩溃边缘，使其无力应对此类严重干旱的影响。 然而，本研究表明，这两个地区都通过长期适应措施增强了韧性，从而避免了潜在的水危机，将原本严重的夏季水资源压力（取水量与可用供水量的比值）分别降低了2.8倍（MW）和5.6倍（NE）。 虽然通过修建水库和开发沿海电力等供给侧策略发挥了一定作用，但主要驱动因素是用水需求管理，在两个地区和各种干旱情景下，用水需求管理占夏季水资源压力缓解效果的 83% 至 92%。 这些成果源于采用先进热电制冷技术和高效工业技术的经济与政治激励措施，以及该地区从制造业向服务业经济的转型。 因此，我们关于21世纪中叶用水需求将增加的预测凸显了一个关键现实：未来的抗旱韧性将需要持续投资于需求侧的效率提升，例如节水型发电系统，以跟上预期的社会经济趋势。

items.title: Who collects, who purchases? Land ownership and biomass acquisition in LMICs
items.title_en: Who collects, who purchases? Land ownership and biomass acquisition in LMICs
items.title_zh: 谁负责收集，谁负责采购？低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的土地所有权与生物质采购
items.summary_en: This study examines the relationship between agricultural land ownership and household fuel use behavior in low- and middle-income countries. Using harmonized household survey data from 11 countries and pooled regressions with country fixed effects, the analysis compares land-owning and landless households across three dimensions of fuel behavior: firewood collection, firewood purchase, and firewood use as the main cooking fuel. The results show that land-owning households are more likely to collect firewood, less likely to purchase it, and more likely to rely on firewood as their primary cooking fuel. These findings persist after controlling for wealth, urban residence, electricity access, and household composition. Interaction models indicate that the land–collection relationship is stable across varying contexts, while the land–purchase relationship is weaker among urban and wealthier households, suggesting that land ownership may shift households from self-collection to purchase rather than out of biomass use altogether. Time-use regressions further show that land-owning households spend more time gathering and preparing fuel, indicating that access to biomass through land lowers cash expenditures but not labor costs. Overall, the findings suggest that land ownership is an important structural determinant of household fuel use behavior and that cooking transitions may depend not only on income and infrastructure, but also on access to biomass resources through land. The analysis demonstrates that the land–energy nexus deserves greater attention in future household energy research and in policies aimed at accelerating equitable and sustained cooking transitions.
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在中低收入国家中，农业土地所有权与家庭燃料使用行为之间的关系。 本研究利用来自11个国家的标准化家庭调查数据，并采用包含国家固定效应的汇总回归分析，从三个燃料行为维度——采集薪柴、购买薪柴以及将薪柴作为主要烹饪燃料——对拥有土地和无地家庭进行了比较。 结果表明，拥有土地的家庭更倾向于采集柴火，较少购买柴火，并且更倾向于将柴火作为主要烹饪燃料。在控制了财富、城市居住状况、用电情况和家庭构成等因素后，这些发现仍然成立。 交互作用模型表明，土地与采集之间的关系在不同情境下均保持稳定，而土地与购买之间的关系在城市家庭和较富裕家庭中则较弱，这表明土地所有权可能会促使家庭从自采转向购买，而非完全放弃生物质能的使用。 时间利用回归分析进一步表明，拥有土地的家庭在采集和准备燃料上花费的时间更多，这表明通过土地获取生物质燃料虽然降低了现金支出，但并未减少劳动力成本。 总体而言，研究结果表明，土地所有权是家庭燃料使用行为的一个重要结构性决定因素，烹饪方式的转型不仅取决于收入和基础设施，还取决于通过土地获取生物质资源的途径。该分析表明，在未来的家庭能源研究以及旨在加速公平和可持续烹饪方式转型的政策中，土地与能源的关联性值得给予更多关注。
